summary: With Witness B at her Exhibit 4 mark and her claim tested at the moment she describes, the world matches the evidence. Her testimony that she watched the car "the whole way in" with "nothing in the way" is contradicted: the truck-tractor and then the refrigerated van semitrailer of Vehicle T block her line of sight for about the last 1.3 s before impact. No further patch is needed; the contradiction is in the testimony.

findings.summary: Witness B could not have watched the car up to impact from where she marked she was standing: Vehicle T's tractor, then its semitrailer, block her view from about t=9.1s.
findings.detail: Her eye-level render at t=9.9s shows the tractor filling the direction of the approaching car; the overhead render shows the truck crossing between her X and the eastbound lanes. The ray-cast agrees (blocked by veh_T_trailer, 28.3 m to the car). She testified "I had a clear view of the car the whole way in. I watched it right up until the moment it hit. Nothing was in the way." (Depo 27:46).

evidence.citation: Depo 28:17 (repeats: until it went under the trailer)

findings.summary: Her account of seeing the car come over the crest and down the grade is physically possible: the view from her mark is clear until about t=9s.

findings.summary: Witness A had a clear line of sight to the passenger sedan at t=2s, consistent with the statement.
Witness C had a clear line of sight to the truck-tractor at t=5s, consistent with the statement.
No skid evidence to test: NTSB found no pre-impact tire marks and no braking.
